Writes rasters to a CF NetCDF file: a single raster, or a time series of rasters on the same grid, one per timestep.

**Toolbox folder:** NetCDF<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** IO, NetCDF, CF, Raster, Time series, Writing<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterToNetcdf`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to write, for a file with a single raster. |
| `inFolder` | folder |  |  | Alternative to the raster: the folder with the rasters of a time series, all on the same grid, taken in the order of their file names. |
| `pTimestamps` | String |  |  | The UTC timestamps of the rasters, as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm, one per line in the order of the rasters. Optional for a single raster, which then has no time. |
| `pVariableName` | String |  | `data` | The name of the variable of the rasters. |
| `pLongName` | String |  |  | The optional long name of the variable. |
| `pUnits` | String |  |  | The optional units of the values of the variable. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outNetcdf` | output file |  | The NetCDF file to write. |
